properties.chose: (a), Anthony's word 2026-10-22 ("Merge 787 and (a)"): keep the findings, filed under each design as now, and the composed reply's note says that a design with no link to the others reads as a cut-off cluster, which composition made and the design alone does not have. The note did not ship in #787 (merged e6d4b5a4f); P7 PR 4 adds it, since PR 4 rewrites the same reply, and re-measures the class once its computed links thread linked designs together. Whether to mark (b) or drop (c) is looked at again after that measurement. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.decision: Found while building phase 7 PR 3 (2026-10-21). Composing 16 designs (the PR 2 fixture: 15 exports, 3,196 nodes) gave 1,910 findings; 118 of the per-design ones were UnthreadedCluster, which a member composed beside others it has no link to reads as (it is cut off from "the main body", which is whichever design is largest). Alone, the same member has no such finding. The reply files them under that design as its own, so a reader sees noise that composition made. Options: (a) leave it, and let the reply's note say a design with no link to the others reads as a cut-off cluster; (b) also run each design's checks alone and mark each finding `only_when_composed` (the honest answer, at about twice the cost: the checks are ~6 s of the composed check's ~6 s); (c) drop structural findings that only say two designs are disjoint, counting what was dropped; (d) wait for PR 4's computed links, which thread linked designs together and shrink the class without removing it. Recorded as brainstorming, not as a proposal. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.name: A composed check keeps the findings the composition made, and its note says a design with no link to the others reads as a cut-off cluster
properties.rationale: A composed check exists to show what only appears when designs are present together; a finding the composition manufactured looks exactly like one it discovered, and a hub owner shown 118 false "cut-off cluster" findings switches the check off. The counter-argument: marking requires a second pass per design, doubling a 6 s call, and PR 4's links may make most of them disappear anyway.
